customReplacement.reason: Owner requested standalone Scale with a substantially redesigned, smooth original UI. The reviewed Breakscale canvas and inspector do not own persistent company economics, engineering project choices or sandbox-to-company workflow. Reuse is limited to its MIT simulation; native semantic controls compose the new interface.

contract.purpose: Scale helps engineers develop systems judgment by growing a simulated company, diagnosing bottlenecks, comparing interventions, and observing consequences.
contract.purposeSource: PRODUCT.md; owner-provided Scale brief and standalone confirmation
contract.canonicalPurpose: Scale helps engineers develop systems judgment by growing a simulated company, diagnosing bottlenecks, comparing interventions, and observing consequences.
contract.driftNote: New local-only project; no existing published product or portfolio contract replaced.
contract.audience: Engineers learning practical systems tradeoffs through play.
contract.job: Diagnose a capacity incident, experiment without spending, then deliver a justified change.
contract.thesis: Warm paper and evergreen instrumentation put a readable living architecture at the center.
contract.system: Manrope headings, DM Sans body, semantic green/amber/red, 8px spacing rhythm, fixed desktop inspector and responsive wrapped/vertical graph. Self-hosted fonts.
contract.signature: Measured traffic flows through selectable infrastructure; the same company can branch into a safe experiment.
contract.risk: A calm light workbench carries an idle game rather than arcade decoration; motion and escalating consequences supply the energy.

projectCheck.command: pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm format:check && pnpm measure

ownerFeedback.note: Owner approved standalone Scale and direct implementation. Final visual direction has not yet received owner acceptance. Independent reviews and browser verification are recorded in artifacts/design and artifacts/verification.
